subject: Post-demo recap — go-live gates, payment route & trial-to-paid readiness (Phoenix AI)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@phoenixai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@phoenixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap — go-live gates, payment route & trial-to-paid readiness (Phoenix AI)

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today, Sofia — great discussion and appreciate the clarity on your success criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

Highlights from today's demo:
- Trial target: 250k generation tokens / week for the first 30 days (baseline usage for the Sales Assist flows).
- Success criteria: 1) model latency < 300ms p50 for standard 1024-length prompts; 2) conversion lift of 8–12% on lead qualification prompts (measured against your current heuristic).
- Data handling: Phoenix AI will need VPC private deployment for PII-sensitive inputs — you mentioned a phased approach (hosted -> dedicated -> private).

Procurement & go-live path options we discussed:
1) Card / immediate self-serve: fastest route to start the trial (no PO).
2) PO + monthly invoice: preferred by Procurement if you'd like a paper trail. Requires a signed SOW and purchase order (typical 10–14 day lead time).
3) Cloud marketplace: possible but will add 2–3 weeks for listing and revenue-share terms (we can pursue in parallel if you want marketplace listing later).

Action items I propose:
- Phoenix Procurement: confirm preferred payment route (card vs PO) and any internal PO cadence or PO holder. (Procurement)
- Ben: prepare a one-page SOW template + SAML/KMS notes for VPC deployment. (Internal)
- Lauren: send over a short trial go/no-go checklist with instrumentation points for the 30-day period. (Internal)
- Monica: schedule kickoff for the trial once payment route confirmed — target billing start aligned to first full week of ingestion.

Attachments: phoenix-go-live-checklist.xlsx (draft trial gates), redwood-pricing-options.pdf (summary of card vs PO pricing differences).

If Procurement can confirm payment route by end of week we can aim to start the trial in the first week of May. Any questions, call me — otherwise I'll follow up with the SOW draft and kickoff invite by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — go-live gates, payment route & trial-to-paid readiness (Phoenix AI)

Thanks Monica — helpful recap. Quick answers from my side: 

- Payment route: Procurement prefers PO for anything over $5k/month; for initial pilot under that threshold they are OK with a procurement card but need the finance owner to approve. I will confirm the expected pilot spend range with Finance today.
- Timeline: product team wants to start lightweight testing as soon as next week, but Procurement will need the SOW + terms to process a PO which could push the start 10–12 days.
- VPC: we'll aim for hosted trial first with anonymized data, then escalate to VPC if the early signals look good.

Can Ben/Monica share the short SOW and the minimum data/instrumentation we need to collect for the conversion lift metric? I'll loop in our analytics lead once we have that.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Product | Phoenix AI
sofia.ramos@phoenixai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — go-live gates, payment route & trial-to-paid readiness (Phoenix AI)

Sofia — adding the SOW SAML/KMS notes and a minimal instrumentation checklist below. Attaching the formal one-page SOW to this thread.

SOW (summary):
- Pilot scope: up to 250k generated tokens/week, 30-day evaluation window.
- Billing: invoice on monthly cadence if PO chosen; otherwise charge card at trial activation.
- Liability/terms: standard Redwood platform T&Cs + SOC2 attestation (we will provide evidence).

Minimal instrumentation (for conversion lift metric):
- Events to capture: prompt_id, session_id, conversion_flag (binary), timestamp, variant (control/with-llm), response_latency_ms, token_count_generated.
- Sampling: 100% instrumentation for funnel entry points used in the pilot cohort; bucket by user_id for deterministic A/B.
- Reporting cadence: weekly export to Phoenix analytics S3 bucket (CSV) + dashboard link.

Attachments in this email: phoenix-go-live-checklist.xlsx (updated), redwood-sow-phoenixai-v1.pdf

Monica — I'll drop the SOW and a DocuSign link for signature. Once Procurement confirms PO cadence we can lock the start date.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — go-live gates, payment route & trial-to-paid readiness (Phoenix AI)

Hi Monica / Ben — Procurement here. We reviewed the SOW and pricing summary. A few clarifying items before we issue a PO: 

1) Billing start alignment: PO must reference a calendar month start. Can Redwood accept a PO that goes live on May 1?
2) SOC2 evidence: please attach the latest SOC2 report or link to your portal where we can download it.
3) Data residency & retention: confirm retention window for logs exported during the pilot (we require 90 days minimum).

We are comfortable proceeding with a one-month PO for the 30-day pilot at the quoted pilot rate if the above are confirmed. Otherwise we will consider card route for an immediate start under $5k.

Please reply with the SOC2 link and confirmation on PO start date — we aim to have PO approved by 29 Apr if everything checks out.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Phoenix AI
